description: This file defines a FastAPI route for answering natural language questions about uploaded Excel files. It includes data models, session handling, schema construction, LLM prompt engineering, query planning (DuckDB or pandas), execution, and conversational response generation.

classes.name: AskExcelQuestionRequest
classes.description: Request schema for asking a question against uploaded Excel data.

classes.name: AskExcelAnswerResponse
classes.description: Response schema returning the generated conversational answer.

classes.name: SheetInfo
classes.description: Dataclass representing metadata for an Excel sheet including filename, sheet name, columns, data types, row count, sample data, and parquet path.

methods.name: List[SheetInfo] _load_session_excel_overview(session_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves metadata and parquet paths for all sheets uploaded in a session.

methods.name: str _build_structured_schema_doc(sheets: List[SheetInfo])
methods.description: Constructs a schema overview string of available DataFrames for prompting the LLM.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _llm_generate_query(question: str, schema_doc: str)
methods.description: Uses Gemini AI to generate a safe query plan (SQL or pandas) based on question and schema description.

methods.name: Dict[str,pd.DataFrame] _register_duckdb_views(con, sheets: List[SheetInfo])
methods.description: Creates DuckDB views for each sheet, backed by parquet or sample data.

methods.name: Tuple[pd.DataFrame,str] _execute_duckdb_query(plan: Dict[str, Any], sheets: List[SheetInfo])
methods.description: Executes a generated DuckDB SQL plan, returning the result DataFrame.

methods.name: Tuple[pd.DataFrame,str] _execute_pandas_op(plan: Dict[str, Any], sheets: List[SheetInfo])
methods.description: Performs a constrained pandas operation based on the plan, avoiding arbitrary code execution.

methods.name: str _llm_conversationalize(question: str, schema_doc: str, plan: Dict[str, Any], result_df: pd.DataFrame)
methods.description: Converts the raw DataFrame result into a concise, natural language answer via Gemini AI.

methods.name: AskExcelAnswerResponse ask_excel_question(request: AskExcelQuestionRequest)
methods.description: Main API endpoint that processes a user question, retrieves session data, plans a query, executes it, and returns a conversational answer.

ctags.name: _execute_pandas_op
ctags.pattern: /^def _execute_pandas_op(plan: Dict[str, Any], sheets: List[SheetInfo]) -> Tuple[pd.DataFrame, str/

ctags.name: _llm_conversationalize
ctags.pattern: /^def _llm_conversationalize(question: str, schema_doc: str, plan: Dict[str, Any], result_df: pd.D/
ctags.signature: (question: str, schema_doc: str, plan: Dict[str, Any], result_df: pd.DataFrame)

ctags.name: answer
ctags.pattern: /^    answer: str = Field(..., description="Conversational answer phrased from the computed result/

ctags.name: question
ctags.pattern: /^    question: str = Field(..., description="Natural language question to answer from the uploade/

ctags.name: session_id
ctags.pattern: /^    session_id: str = Field(..., description="Chat session ID that owns uploaded Excel files.")$/
